model_description: Northstar LLM 13B is a 13-billion-parameter open-weights transformer language model trained on a curated multilingual web corpus. Released under Apache 2.0. Distributed via Hugging Face and via SaaS API.
model_summary: Open-weights 13B parameter multilingual LLM under Apache 2.0.
intended_purpose: General-purpose text generation, summarisation, classification, and conversational tasks. Designed as a foundation for downstream task-specific fine-tuning.
intended_users: Enterprises fine-tuning for specific use cases
intended_use_context: Pre-training foundation. Downstream deployers retain responsibility for task-specific evaluation, mitigation, and compliance.
out_of_scope_use: Prohibited practices under Article 5 of the EU AI Act
Use in high-risk Annex III contexts without independent evaluation by the deployer
Generation of CSAM, terrorism content, or other unlawful material
Direct medical, legal, or financial advice without human review
model_architecture: 13B parameter decoder-only transformer with grouped-query attention, RoPE positional embeddings, and 8K context window.
training_data_description: Mixed multilingual corpus including filtered Common Crawl, Wikipedia, public domain literature, code repositories, and licensed editorial content. Total ~3.2 trillion tokens after deduplication and filtering. Detailed composition in public training-data summary URL.
known_data_gaps: Underrepresentation of low-resource languages (notably Sub-Saharan African and Indigenous languages). Code corpus is heavily weighted toward Python, JavaScript, and Rust.
evaluation_summary: Evaluated on standard LLM benchmarks (MMLU, HellaSwag, ARC, HumanEval, MGSM). Bias evaluations conducted using BBQ and BOLD. Safety evaluations include refusal rates on harmful prompts and jailbreak resistance. Full evaluation report linked in technical documentation.
known_limitations: Standard limitations of large language models apply: hallucination, sensitivity to prompt phrasing, and limited reasoning beyond training distribution. Multilingual performance varies by language. Knowledge cutoff: September 2025.
synthetic_content_disclosure: Outputs include a machine-readable provenance signal compatible with C2PA where supported by the deployment surface. Deployers using the open weights are required to implement Article 50(2) marking in their downstream products.
ai_interaction_disclosure: Where the model is exposed in a conversational interface by Northstar's hosted API, users are notified at session start that they are interacting with an AI system. Open-weights deployers are responsible for their own Article 50(1) disclosures.
copyright_policy: Training corpus respects robots.txt and TDM opt-out signals (Article 4 of EU Directive 2019/790). Opted-out content was excluded prior to training. A full copyright policy and opt-out request mechanism is published at https://northstar.example.org/copyright-policy.
